text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone was so fast... I tried to catch up,
but I couldn't at all..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Even after training so hard with Trainer-san... *sniffle*
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard. You can always try again next time.
Don't push yourself too hard. Let's try again another time.
Don't cry! You're gonna be the number one Umamusume in Japan, right?!
Don't cry—you're going to be Japan's number one Umamusume, right?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... I will do my best!
I'll work super hard... and I'll definitely win next time!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Because I have someone working hard right beside me,
so close by!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "...You're right. I can't become the best Umamusume in Japan if all I do is cry."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, Trainer.
Please train me even harder.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So, please stay by my side and watch me
until I become the number one Umamusume in Japan!!
